decisions.difference: A: (Cervical os closed), (Small uterus)  vs  B: absent
decisions.reason: The review question names "closed cervix and small uterus" next to adnexal mass, so they are elements to check; whether they are required is the unsettled priority/diagnosis decision below.

decisions.difference: A: adnexal mass AND Cervical os closed AND Small uterus  vs  B: adnexal mass alone
decisions.final_expr: (and (finding … "Mass of uterine adnexa") (finding … "Cervical os closed") (finding … "Small uterus"))
decisions.reason: The page writes the item as "adnexal mass (closed cervix and small uterus)"; A encodes every word, while the page does not say whether the parenthetical is required or descriptive.

decisions.difference: A: adnexal mass AND Cervical os closed AND Small uterus  vs  B: adnexal mass alone (ectopic pregnancy rule)
decisions.final_expr: (and recent-TOP (finding … "Mass of uterine adnexa") (finding … "Cervical os closed") (finding … "Small uterus"))
decisions.reason: "If adnexal mass, ectopic pregnancy likely" refers back to the question's item "adnexal mass (closed cervix and small uterus)"; kept consistent with the priority rule, same open question.

decisions.difference: A: (Products of conception in vagina)  vs  B: absent
decisions.reason: The page says "products of conception visible" without restricting where, so POC in the vagina is covered alongside POC at the os.

decisions.difference: A: open os AND (bleeding OR POC at os OR POC in vagina)  vs  B: open os AND (bleeding OR POC at os) (incomplete TOP rule)
decisions.final_expr: (or (finding … "Bleeding from vagina") (finding … "Products of conception at uterine os cervix") (finding … "Products of conception in vagina"))
decisions.reason: Same as the check_for decision: "products of conception visible" names no location.

notes: Both builds agree on scope (only the post-TOP review section is encoded), trigger, vitals thresholds, Hb < 6 omission and the enlarged-uterus OR (open os AND …) grouping. All differences stem from two readings: the adnexal-mass parenthetical (unsettled, A's literal reading kept) and the location of visible POC. Rule descriptions are A's. B's extra clinician questions (grouping of the incomplete-TOP question, Hb) and its onset-date caveat were merged into the remaining-questions file.
